approved.en: Russian drone strikes hit a Ukrainian railway station, killing 13, and attacks have cut power to thousands as the Kherson ceasefire ends. In Oleshky the localized truce ended, ending evacuations while aid vehicles continue to be attacked. Ukrainian forces struck an oil facility in Russia's Samara Oblast and a rocket fuel factory, while Russia reported a drone strike on a Ukrainian railway station. Cyber attacks disrupted emergency alert apps in both countries after the truce ended. The conflict caused 75,767 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
approved.nb: Russiske droner angrep en ukrainsk jernbanestasjon, og 13 personer ble drept, og angrep har kuttet strømmen til tusenvis etter at våpenhvilen i Kherson tok slutt. I Oleshky opphørte den lokale våpenhvilen, evakueringene ble avsluttet mens hjelpeskjøretøy fortsatt blir angrepet. Ukrainske styrker slo et oljefelt i Russland i Samara oblast og et rakettdrivstoffverk, mens Russland rapporterte et droneangrep på en ukrainsk jernbanestasjon. Cyberangrep forstyrret nødvarslingsapper i begge land etter at våpenhvilen opphørte. Konflikten forårsaket 75 767 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Israeli forces have ended a ten-day siege of Hebron, withdrawing after detaining residents and threatening a broader West Bank offensive. In Gaza, the IDF has killed four more Hamas operatives, including a participant in the Oct. 7 attack, in recent strikes. Settler violence continues in the West Bank, with a mother fearing her son’s killer after an attack on a town. Iran warned that renewed war with the US could outlast the previous conflict. The conflict produced 21,440 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

I Gaza har IDF drept fire flere Hamas-operatører, inkludert en deltaker i angrepet 7. oktober, i nylige angrep. Bosetters vold fortsetter på Vestbredden, der en mor frykter morderen av sønnen etter et angrep på en by. Iran advarte om at en fornyet krig med USA kan vare lenger enn den forrige konflikten. Konflikten førte til 21 440 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

Israel reported a controlled detonation of a strike in southern Lebanon, and Lebanese military courts have charged 13 individuals over a seized Hezbollah explosives truck. Lebanon has charged 13 people for confiscated Hezbollah explosives, reflecting heightened security actions. The United Nations reports 300,000 people displaced in Lebanon, and Qatar has pledged reconstruction funding for the south. The UCDP recorded 4,335 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

approved.en: Iranian Revolutionary Guard forces reported three tankers ablaze and mines striking four tankers in the Strait of Hormuz while Iran's foreign minister welcomed U.S. outreach during a Qatari mediation visit. Iran's supreme leader ordered the military to expand retaliation plans without geographic limits and the security chief debated discarding the nuclear weapons ban. Iranian envoys met Qatari mediators as the United States threatened strikes after the midterm elections, and Iran's strikes on U.S. Middle East bases disabled early-warning systems. 123 battle-related deaths occurred in 2024, according to UCDP.

Irans øverste leder beordret militæret til å utvide gjengjeldelsesplanene uten geografiske begrensninger, og sikkerhetslederen diskuterte å forkaste forbudet mot atomvåpen. Iranske sendebud møtte qatarske meglere da USA truet med angrep etter midtveisvalgene, og Irans angrep på amerikanske baser i Midtøsten slo ut tidligvarselsystemene. 123 kamprelaterte dødsfall skjedde i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

The Houthis are reported to be using Russian satellites to coordinate strikes, and a cargo vessel bound for Pakistan was targeted near the Hormuz Strait. UN investigators are probing the death of a staff member in Houthi custody, and fighting around Taiz and Aden has displaced 290,000 people, including pregnant women. The conflict caused 918 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Damascus seized 4.3 million Captagon pills and dismantled thirty drug networks, and it participated in Cairo Water Week to discuss agricultural and water cooperation. The UCDP recorded 2,732 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

approved.en: Drone strikes have hit two power stations in eastern Sudan, causing a widespread blackout and prompting Sudan to lodge complaints with the UN and African Union against Ethiopia for cross-border attacks. The RSF continues to use drones against civilian infrastructure, while the UN is preparing talks with the RSF on a civilian transition. Sudan’s government has accused Ethiopia of supporting the attacks, and the conflict has expanded to include disputes over the power grid. 4,680 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

RSF-militsen fortsetter å bruke droner mot sivil infrastruktur, mens FN forbereder samtaler med RSF om en sivil overgang. Sudans regjering har anklaget Etiopia for å støtte angrepene, og konflikten har utvidet seg til å omfatte tvister om strømnettet. 4 680 drepte i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Sudan General Al-Atta says Puntland mercenaries are fighting alongside RSF, while intense clashes continue in Malakal and an ambush on a Warrap road killed five people. A police officer apologized after a viral video of a Juba assault, claiming the victim was a gang member, and the deputy minister of ICT warned against abusing freedom of expression. Communal violence persists, with a school girl killed by an unintentional RPG explosion in Yei and a cleric shot dead in Juba, while peace talks were launched in Tonj East to end deadly communal violence. The UCDP counted 2 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

En politimann ba om unnskyldning etter en viral video av et angrep i Juba, og hevdet at offeret var medlem av en gjeng, og visedepartementet for IKT advarte mot å misbruke ytringsfriheten. Kommunal vold vedvarer, med en skolejente drept av en utilsiktet RPG-eksplosjon i Yei og en prest skutt død i Juba, mens fredssamtaler ble igangsatt i Tonj East for å få slutt på dødelig kommunal vold. There were 2,824 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

approved.en: Mawisley militias have withdrawn from front lines in central Somalia while Puntland mercenaries are reported fighting alongside Sudanese RSF forces, and Sudan’s army says fighters from northern Somalia back the RSF. The United States has joined an East African nation in conducting airstrikes against a $100 million-earning group linked to the 9/11 attacks, and the UAE carried out its first drone strike against al-Shabaab in nearly a year. Somali pirates seized an Iranian fishing vessel, rescuing seven Pakistani crew members, and the UN political mission in Somalia ended after three decades. Uganda and Ethiopia are pulling their troops out after long deployments, and the African Union is withdrawing from four Lower Shabelle bases. The conflict caused 2,284 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
approved.nb: Mawisley-militsene har trukket seg tilbake fra frontlinjene i sentrale Somalia, mens Puntland-leiesoldater skal kjempe sammen med den sudanske RSF-militsen, og den sudanske hæren (SAF) sier at krigere fra Nord-Somalia støtter RSF. USA har sammen med en østafrikansk nasjon gjennomført luftangrep mot en gruppe som tjener 100 millioner dollar og er knyttet til 9/11-angrepene, og De forente arabiske emirater utførte sitt første droneram mot al-Shabaab på nesten ett år. Somaliske pirater tok kontroll over et iransk fiskefartøy, og reddet syv pakistanske mannskap, og FN-politimissionen i Somalia ble avsluttet etter tre tiår. Uganda og Etiopia trekker sine tropper tilbake etter lange oppdrag, og Den afrikanske unionen trekker seg fra fire baser i Lower Shabelle. Konflikten forårsaket 2 284 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.
